Title: Every freshly-generated Factory package is Blocked from commercial export (0 Ready of 11)
Description: A fresh 'Generate Now' Factory batch produces assets whose Commercial Readiness check 'Generator completed' always FAILs with 'No generator version recorded on this asset' -- a metadata field the Factory/Autopilot pipeline never writes. Combined with 'Duplicate check complete: WARNING -- no production fingerprint computed', every asset from a brand-new Factory run is permanently blocked (Export Readiness Dashboard: 0 Ready / 11 Blocked) with no owner-facing control to fix the missing metadata. This defeats the literal primary user goal (Generate -> Preview -> Export -> Download).
Evidence: workflowA/09_export_tab.png; workflowA_exportDeepDive.mjs output showing 'Generator completed: FAIL -- No generator version recorded on this asset' on a genuinely fresh autopilotcplan... asset (Commercial Readiness 68%25 BLOCKED); reproduced again offline in Workflow E.
Recommended Fix: Wire the Factory/Autopilot generation pipeline to stamp a generatorVersion (and a production fingerprint for duplicate-check) onto every PortfolioAsset/production record it creates
column9: so the Commercial Readiness engine's 'Generator completed' and 'Duplicate check complete' checks can actually pass for legitimately-generated assets.

Title: Session Summary claims '100% Factory Efficiency' while 0 of 10 packages are export-ready
Description: After Mark Session Complete, the Session Summary shows Packages Produced 10 / Ready 0 / Repair 10 / Factory Efficiency 100% / Business Outcome 94 side by side. An owner skimming this card would reasonably believe the run succeeded, when in fact zero of the ten patterns are sellable yet.
Recommended Fix: Either compute 'Factory Efficiency' from real sellable output (0 Ready / 10 Produced would not be 100%), or relabel it to make clear it measures automation/process completion, not commercial readiness.

Title: Progress screen shows the same blocking-reason message duplicated 3x verbatim
Description: 'Commercial Readiness 68%25 is below the 95%25 threshold. Blocked -- override required to export.' is printed three times back-to-back in the same paragraph while 10 tasks are actually blocked, instead of one message per distinct reason (or a single de-duplicated summary).
Recommended Fix: De-duplicate blocking-reason strings before rendering; if multiple tasks share one reason show it once with a count.

Title: 10 of 10 REPAIR-status packages are invisible and unreachable from Today's Production
Description: Session Summary reports 'Repair: 10' but the Review tab (the only review surface in Today's Production) only ever shows the 1 item in REVIEW status. There is no visible tab, filter, or link from Today's Production to see or act on the 9-10 REPAIR-status packages the same session just reported.
Evidence: workflowA/08_review_tab.png + workflowA/07_after_mark_complete.png (Session Summary 'Repair 10' vs Review tab showing only 1 item)
Recommended Fix: Add a Repair view/filter to Today's Production (or a clear cross-link to wherever Repair items actually live) so 'Repair: 10' is not a number with no owner-facing destination.

Title: Two top-nav buttons appear simultaneously highlighted/active on every screen
Description: '🏭 Today's Production' and '✨ ออกแบบให้ฉันวันนี้' both render in the active/highlighted blue state at the same time on every single screen visited in this audit (Mission Control, Today's Production, Portfolio, Backup, iPad portrait/landscape) -- not just after navigating between them. Makes it unclear which section is actually current.
Evidence: crawl screenshots for all 10 screens; workflowA/*.png; workflowF/ipad_portrait_todays_production.png
Recommended Fix: Fix the active-nav-item logic so exactly one top-level nav button is highlighted at a time.

Title: 6 of 9 modal dialogs do not close on Escape, and focus is not moved into the dialog on open
Screen: Portfolio Manager (and shared modal pattern app-wide)
Description: Escape does not close AssetPreviewDialog (confirmed live) and code inspection shows only 3 of the 9 components using the shared 'portfolio-modal-backdrop' pattern implement Escape handling (CollectionAssignmentDialog, CreateCollectionDialog, CollectionDetailPanel). The other 6 -- including all 4 new Hotfix v1.0.1 dialogs (AssetPreviewDialog, MarketplaceSelectionDialog, DownloadCenter, SubmissionHistoryPanel) plus PortfolioHealthCheckPanel and PortfolioImportPanel -- do not. Additionally, focus is not programmatically moved into the dialog when it opens (document.activeElement stayed outside role=dialog).
Evidence: a11y/01_preview_dialog_open.png + a11y/02_after_escape_attempt.png; script output 'DIALOG COUNT AFTER ESCAPE KEY: 1'; grep confirming 6/9 components lack Escape handling
Recommended Fix: Add a shared modal hook/component (Escape-to-close + initial focus move + focus trap) and apply it to all 9 portfolio-modal-backdrop consumers instead of duplicating ad hoc dialog logic per component.

Title: No landmark regions (nav/main) for the app shell
Description: The 11-button top navigation bar and the page's main content area have no <nav>/role=navigation or <main>/role=main landmarks. Screen-reader users have no way to jump directly to navigation or skip to main content -- they must tab linearly through the same ~13 controls on every screen before reaching page content.
Evidence: accessibilityCheck.mjs output: 'NAV LANDMARK COUNT: 0' / 'MAIN LANDMARK COUNT: 0'
Recommended Fix: Wrap the top nav bar in <nav aria-label="Main navigation"> and the routed page content in <main>; consider a 'skip to content' link.

Title: Design Workbench's third panel is crushed unreadable at iPad-portrait width
Description: At 834px width (iPad portrait) the 3-column workbench layout does not adapt -- the rightmost panel (Live Preview/Inspector/etc.) is squeezed to roughly 50px wide, showing only single clipped characters of each word, effectively unusable. The same screen at 1194px (iPad landscape) renders all 3 panels correctly. Document scrollWidth still equals clientWidth at both sizes, so this would not be caught by an automated horizontal-overflow check alone -- only visual inspection surfaces it.
Recommended Fix: Below a width threshold (somewhere between 834px and 1194px) collapse the 3-column workbench to a stacked or tabbed single-column layout instead of squeezing all three columns to fit.

Title: Exported/generated asset filenames are long internal-ID slugs shown directly to the owner
Screen: Today's Production -> Review; Portfolio grid cards
Description: Freshly generated assets are named like 'pastel-dream-botanical-floral-toss-pattern-seamless-pattern-autopilotcplan20260805m53ykzcitem20260805b75y9e9repair1' -- concatenated plan/item/repair IDs with no spacing, shown as the primary label on Review cards and Portfolio thumbnails. Not readable at a glance, and looks like a bug/placeholder to a non-technical owner.
Recommended Fix: Show a short human-friendly display name (style + date, or a sequence number) as the primary label, and keep the full slug as a secondary/technical detail (e.g. under 'Asset ID').

Title: Export tab's asset picker defaults to an unrelated/older asset instead of one from the batch just produced
Description: Immediately after a Factory run that produced 10 new patterns, the Commercial Package Builder's asset dropdown on the Export tab defaults to selecting a pre-existing, unrelated asset ('dark-floral-mix-retro-70s-x-plaid-check...') rather than one of the just-produced batch, even though the surrounding Business Metrics panel is clearly reporting on 'today'.
Recommended Fix: Default the asset picker to the most recently produced/most relevant asset from the current session instead of an arbitrary/first item.
